events.summary: We've updated the demo! events.title: Memento Resonance Free Demo Now Available!
events.summary: The free demo of Memento Resonance is now available! Memento Resonance is a monster-collecting roguelite turn-based strategy game in which you form bonds with monsters encountered as enemies and climb the tower together. Unable to fight on her own, a girl named Koharu enters a colossal tower in pursuit of her father's shadow. Offer food to monsters during battle and form “Resonance” with them to welcome them as new allies. Relics found during your journey can be equipped to your allies' skills.
